From c9ace69cff4a626c9e1c21181cd2b957ae2a3fb0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suresh Srinivas <suresh@apache.org>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2013 07:42:06 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] HADOOP-9563. Fix incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523.
 Contributed by Tian Hong Wang.

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/hadoop/common/trunk@1482709 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
index 819a9216bd9..24846f849a5 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@
  * A helper class for getting build-info of the java-vm. 
  * 
  */
-@InterfaceAudience.Private
+@InterfaceAudience.LimitedPrivate({"HBase"})
 @InterfaceStability.Unstable
 public class PlatformName {
   /**
@@ -49,7 +49,6 @@
   public static final boolean IBM_JAVA = JAVA_VENDOR_NAME.contains("IBM");
   
   public static void main(String[] args) {
-    System.out.println("platform name: " + PLATFORM_NAME);
-    System.out.println("java vendor name: " + JAVA_VENDOR_NAME);
+    System.out.println(PLATFORM_NAME);
   }
 }
--

+    (Tian Hong Wang via suresh)
+
 Release 2.0.4-alpha - 2013-04-25 
 
   INCOMPATIBLE CHANGES

### Modifications in Each File

1. **PlatformName.java**
   - The annotation `@InterfaceAudience.Private` was changed to `@InterfaceAudience.LimitedPrivate({"HBase"})`. This modification indicates that the class is now intended for limited use, specifically for HBase, rather than being private.
   - The `main` method was modified to remove two `System.out.println` statements that printed the platform name and Java vendor name. Instead, it now only prints the platform name.

2. **CHANGES.txt**
   - A new entry was added to document the fix for the incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523, specifically noting the issue as HADOOP-9563 and crediting the contribution to Tian Hong Wang.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The changes in `PlatformName.java` address a specific incompatibility issue that was introduced in a previous patch (HADOOP-9523). By altering the audience annotation and modifying the output in the `main` method, the patch aims to clarify the intended use of the `PlatformName` class and streamline its output. The entry in `CHANGES.txt` serves to inform users of this fix, linking the changes made in the code to the broader context of the project's development history.
